theorems.name: Submission.cbrg_exists_countable_disjoint_refinement
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Set (Euclid P) → Prop), (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ U ∧ p W) → ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Countable ι) (W A : ι → Set (Euclid P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, W i ⊆ U) ∧ (∀ i, p (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, A i ⊆ W i) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) ∧ ⋃ i, A i = U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
